description: Get the claims from an unlocked loss run extraction: one entry per claim with carrier, insured, policy, claim number, claimant, dates of loss and report, status, and paid, reserve and incurred amounts. This only reads the claims: it doesn't change anything in LossRunGuru or spend credits, and can be called again safely. A locked extraction must be unlocked with unlock_result first. For real use, pass save_to to write the claims to a CSV or Excel file and get a short summary back. Without save_to the claims are returned inline as JSON, and results over about 40,000 characters are cut off. save_to must end in .csv, .xlsx or .json, matching the format, and won't replace an existing file unless overwrite is true.

format.description: json, csv or xlsx. Defaults to the save_to file's extension, otherwise json. xlsx needs save_to.

id.description: Extraction id. The extraction must be unlocked (status completed).

overwrite.description: Replace save_to if it already exists. Defaults to false.

save_to.description: Absolute path of a .csv, .xlsx or .json file to write the claims to. Missing folders are created.

name: get_claims
title: Get extracted claims
